content_zh: 动态雕塑（丝织物，金属支架，旋转机构）
将中国传统丝织物——“罗”——重新构造为悬浮且持续旋转的植物造型。纤维的自然生长形态与类似经轮的机械旋转方式并置：一方面回溯了传统织造工艺的历史，另一方面也直面现代文化机制下其意义被视觉化、形式化与复制化的过程。旋转的“罗”既是历史的隐喻，又是对当下的反思——在被观看、记录与转述的循环中，许多文化记忆被重构为一种可被消费的景观。
作品参加中国美术馆展览“未来诗篇——技艺的笔触与留白”。
content_en: Kinetic Sculpture (Silk gauze, Metal Armature, Rotating mechanism)

The work uses the traditional Chinese silk material - 'luo' - to construct a floating and rotating plant-look structure. The natural form of fibers and the prayer wheel-styled mechanical rotation are juxtaposed to recall the history of ancient weaving technique, and meanwhile to refer to the process that meanings are visualised, symbolised and duplicated under modern cultural mode. The rotating 'luo' can be seen as a metaphor of the past, or a reflection on the present - cultural memories are reshaped into consumable spectacles through the cycle of viewing, recording and paraphrasing.
The work is included in the exhibition 'Future Poetics: Digital Traces and Intended Blank' held by the National Art Museum of China.
